🚀 Deal created 8/4/26 · Closed Won 8/11/26 | $1,933
Page 1

Campaign performance0

LinkedIn campaigns that influenced pipe or revenue in-period. Pipe = Fibbler open + closed-lost; revenue = closed-won. Campaign buckets (1-to-1 ABM, Mid-Market, Strategic, Remarketing, Closed Lost Accounts, TLA) sit above the campaign list. 15 per page (or Show all). Expand a row for top 10 companies by revenue, then pipe. Names cleaned; type and Remarketing/Awareness badges replace raw format.

Partnership deals removed. The campaign list, summary, and efficiency use Fibbler campaign-level totals that cannot be split by deal, so they stay the same; partnership companies are hidden from each campaign’s company list.

Page 1

Methodology: Fibbler campaign-level influence; pipe and revenue can double-count across campaigns (a deal may appear under every campaign that touched it). Same period windows as the rest of this page. LinkedIn only. Company drilldown is top 10 by influenced revenue, then pipeline, among cohort deals that campaign touched in-period. Campaign Manager links use account 507701568.

Things to Know

  • Cohort. New Business (Inbound/Outbound), Cross-sell, and Upsell with 3+ LinkedIn paid clicks at the company. Renewals are excluded from main KPIs. Time Frame switches the window; rules stay the same.
  • Create vs close. Pipeline and journeys use create date. Influenced revenue uses close date (Closed Won only). Deal lists (deal table, campaign-by-deal, campaign buckets) show open and lost deals by create date and Closed Won deals by close date, so a deal won in the period is listed even if it was created earlier. Each deal appears once per period.
  • Spend. All spend is LinkedIn account spend in-window (Nov is MTD), split by campaign from LinkedIn's own delivery data. Campaign rows, buckets, and the overview KPI therefore reconcile to the same LinkedIn total. YTD account spend $293,413.
  • Cost per opp. Period account ad spend divided by influenced opportunities created in the period (any stage, same 3+ paid click cohort; New Business combined per company, Upsell and Cross-sell counted per deal, renewals excluded). Without partnerships divides the same spend by non-partner opportunities created.
  • Period comparison. Last full month compares to the month before, Last 3 months to the 3 months before, and Month to date to the same days of the prior month (deals, pipeline, and revenue only; daily spend for the prior month is not on file, so Ad spend and Cost per opp show no comparison in Month to date). YTD has no comparison because prior-year deal data is not in this pull. Prior-period deals use their current stage. Green is favorable, red unfavorable, grey neutral (spend).
  • Pipeline vs revenue. Open pipeline = any stage that is not Closed Won or Closed Lost (Demo highlighted yellow). Revenue = Closed Won closed in-period.
  • Partial month. November 2026 is partial (Fibbler data as of Nov 3 ET; 3 of 30 days). Last 3 months = Aug to Oct 2026 full months; last full month = October 2026.
  • Partnerships switch. With / Without at the top recomputes overview KPIs, charts, deal tables, campaign-by-deal cards, journeys, and campaign buckets. Fibbler campaign-level totals in the campaign list, summary, and efficiency cannot be split by deal and stay the same.
  • Partnership. Partnership accounts come from the Chili Piper HubSpot partnership company list (623 companies). 53 of 207 influenced companies (78 deals) match by company name after normalizing case, punctuation, and legal suffixes. They carry a Partnership tag, and the Without partnership deals overview removes them. Ad spend is the same in both views.
  • Journeys. When present, cards show 12 months of paid activity ending on create. Est. Spend uses Sep+Oct 2026 blended CPM/CPC (not booked spend).
  • Campaign buckets. 1-to-1 ABM, Mid-Market, Strategic, Remarketing, Closed Lost Accounts, and TLA roll up campaigns by name. Spend, impressions, and clicks cover every bucket campaign in the period. Pipeline and revenue count each cohort deal once per bucket (a deal touched by several 1 to 1 campaigns counts once); a deal touched by two buckets shows in both. TLA matches campaigns whose name contains TLA or Thought Leader, so a campaign can belong to more than one bucket (for example Mid-Market webinars that use Thought Leader Ads count in both Mid-Market and TLA). Deals without Fibbler campaign touchpoints cannot be bucketed, so bucket pipeline and revenue are floors.
  • Campaign performance. Segments: Remarketing, Mid-Market, Strategic (incl. 1 to 1 / Enterprise). Mix and efficiency are campaign-level; pipe/rev can double-count across campaigns. Spotlight is out of ad-type charts.
  • Ambiguous campaigns. Names that do not clearly match a segment are listed for Tim in chili-piper-fibbler-dashboard-ambiguous-campaigns.md.
